scoring.explanation: Priority = 45% vote demand + 30% how often the theme appears + 25% average severity. Each part is scaled so the highest-scoring theme = 1.0. Votes use a linear scale because the top theme has 2.2x the votes of the median theme (log applies above 10x).

themes.recommended_action: Centralize run status, logs, notifications, retries and controls in the execution experience.

Improve action search, categories, naming and catalog organization so users can quickly find the correct action.
Use the originating page and entity context to pre-select known targets and reduce repeated input.
Improve safe action creation with previews, test runs, drafts, versioning and unsaved-change protection.
